author: Mick Collins
text:
ABBOTT’S COMPANY POLICIES ARE NOTHING BUT LIES.
• They knew I was innocent with an unblemished work record but tried to wreck my family and reputation when I blew the health and safety whistle.
• The racist 2-tier aspect and overreaction in my case and under-reaction based on skin colour in others is unequivocal. Digging up old non-events in my case and turning blind eye and covering up instant extremely serious complaints reacting entirely to skin colour on every occasion.
• Three directors marking each other’s homework, sacking me, when they were the accused.
• Backing someone to get me sacked they knew had tried to kill me.
• Presenting false paperwork and lying at tribunal.
• Influence getting police to cover up phone calls and issue harassment warnings against me for sending in lie detector test results.
• Ruining my career years later, intentionally lying that I never worked there.
• Trying to get me arrested again because I complained that they broke the law on this too. 
• Shooting themselves in the foot a year later writing to me about my duties as a former employee, then every HR department worldwide stonewalling me as I chased them seeking  justice.
